title: Bounded candidate-event upkeep activation

acceptance_conditions.condition: PG-WP6 disabled implementation is merged from an exact tested head.
Candidate identity is deterministic and source-linked.
Only existing programme identities and allowlisted event/source types are accepted.
Persistence is append-only, refuses overwrite and is limited to the dedicated candidate root.
Main, merge, approval, publication, programme creation and accepted Programme Events remain impossible.
acceptance_conditions.evidence: contract, registry, source inspection and tests

acceptance_conditions.condition: Per-run cap, duplicate rejection, first-valid time and forbidden authority payload checks fail closed.
DA2 strict ruleset and exact required context are re-verified without bypass.

warnings: PASS enables repository candidate-file persistence on dedicated upkeep branches.
Every output remains an unapproved candidate and has no authority effect.
A separate human-governed decision is still required to convert any candidate into an accepted Programme Event.
Admission enforcement and the read-only Control Plane route remain deferred.
The collector cannot open or merge PRs, approve changes, write main, create programmes or publish.
work_after_approval: Record the operator decision and exact accepted head.
Set the upkeep registry to ACTIVE_BOUNDED_APPEND_ONLY with enabled true and candidate_persistence true.
Bind activation_decision_id to the accepted PG-G7 decision.
Keep all permanent prohibitions and branch/path caps unchanged.
Run focused and complete repository tests plus OVC merge readiness.
Squash-merge the bounded activation PR when all checks pass.
Record the merge receipt and mark OVC-PG-v0.2 completed unless a new bounded packet is separately admitted.
rollback: Set enabled and candidate_persistence false through a new non-destructive decision, stop candidate generation, discard unaccepted working candidates, and preserve accepted decisions, source findings, hashes, PRs and merge receipts.
